title: Strawberry Crunch Poke Cake

components.name: For the Cake
ingredients: One 15.25 oz box white cake mix, plus ingredients on back of box to prepare
directions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Liberally grease a 9x13 light metal rectangular baking pan with cooking spray; set aside.

Prepare cake mix according to package directions for a white cake. Add batter to the prepared pan and bake according to package instructions (around 22–25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean).
Cool completely, then poke holes all over the cake using the tines of a fork.

Dissolve strawberry gelatin in 1 cup boiling water, then stir in 1 cup cold water. Pour the gelatin mixture slowly over the entire cake, filling the holes. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or until set.

components.name: For the Frosting
directions: Beat the cream cheese until smooth. Add heavy whipping cream, confectioners' sugar, and vanilla extract. Beat until stiff peaks form and the frosting is light and fluffy.
Spread frosting over the chilled cake.

components.name: For the Strawberry Crunch Topping
ingredients: Fresh strawberries for garnish (optional but recommended)
directions: Combine crushed Golden Oreos, melted butter, and strawberry gelatin powder. Mix until all Oreos are coated.
Sprinkle the crunch topping evenly over the frosted cake. Garnish with fresh strawberries if desired.

notes: Total time approximately 5 hours including chilling. Serves 12–15.
